channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeremy Sochan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeremy Sochan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Brown on Sochan:

“When you look at Jeremy, you like his size right off the bat, especially for a forward. OG is of that size, but no one else is really of that size.”

Jaylen Brown on Jeremy Sochan, Feb 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Sounds like Jeremy Sochan will take Mo Diawara’s minutes.

“I want to see what we got with Jeremy before the playoffs,”

Mike Brown on Jeremy Sochan, Feb 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Pop on Jeremy going back to shooting FTs with two hands:

“He decided that he felt comfortable enough to go do that. He did it, and that’s where we are.”

Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan, Oct 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Wemby on possibly being without Sochan rest of season:

“He has played so many precious minutes for us, doing all the dirty (work) and the hard job. He has just been such a great asset for us on both sides of the court.”

Victor Wembanyama on Jeremy Sochan, Mar 31, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Wemby on if he's glad he doesn't have to go up against Sochan:

“Oh, yeah. You can count on your fingers how many guys can guard like him in this league. He is such a great asset and he is just a sophomore. He has so much more to show.”

Victor Wembanyama on Jeremy Sochan, Feb 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Devin Vassell on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Vassell on Sochan not making the Rising Stars game a 2nd-straight year:

“I don't think they like us when it comes to Rising Stars. I think my second year, I feel like I should have been a part of that too. And I think that just puts a chip on your shoulder. It did for me.”

Devin Vassell on Jeremy Sochan, Jan 31, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Pop on Jeremy pre-game:

“It’s like a new world for him. Every night is an education – guys he’s guarding, guys guarding him, keeping the team together in whatever offensive situation we are in. It’s a lot to think about when that hasn’t really been your focus.”

Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan, Dec 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Chris Paul, Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Pop on Jeremy Sochan's progression as PG:

“Well it's been 5 or 6 games, and he's not gonna be Chris Paul in 6 games. He's learning a lot and likes the challenge. Every game is an education for him—offense against that pressure is tough. Over time hopefully we'll handle that better.”

Gregg Popovich on Chris Paul, Jeremy Sochan, Nov 6, 2023. Source: reddit.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Pop on how Sochan looked playing the point vs. Miami:

“I don’t want to make any bold statements about good, bad or indifferent, but he’s energetic, he’s got great pace and he enjoys it, so we will see how it goes.”

Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan, Oct 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Pop on Sochan's offensive aggressiveness:

“We pushed the pace pretty good and he ran the floor well and people saw him and they threw it ahead like you are supposed to do. He ran hard, he ran to the rim.”

Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan, Oct 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Jakob Poeltl on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Poeltl on Sochan:

“He was great today. He was aggressive on defense on Karl-Anthony Towns. He was aggressive on offense trying to look for his shots, he's looking very comfortable already. If he can keep that up, that aggressiveness, that's great for us.”

Jakob Poeltl on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jeremy Sochan, Oct 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
More from Pop on Sochan:

“He’s got a lot of personality like Keldon Johnson does. And he is aggressive. I think it’s a good opportunity for him to play with those guys and see how he handles things when the lights go on, so to speak.”

Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Jeremy Sochan, Oct 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Pop on Sochan starting right away:

“Somebody has to start, right? It’s not like we have veterans who are ready to go. I thought it would be good to throw him in the fire and see how he responds.”

Gregg Popovich on Jeremy Sochan, Oct 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Josh Primo on Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Primo on how #Spurs decision to sit Sochan in Vegas underscores how they put health of their players first:

“The Spurs really want the best for the players. That's what makes this organization great. They actually care. They care about a person's well being.”

Josh Primo on Jeremy Sochan, Jul 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
